title: Ahsoka Tano
description: Ahsoka Tano was the Padawan learner of Anakin Skywalker before she left the Jedi Order to chart her own path in the Force. During the reign of the Empire, she worked to undermine her former master in the Rebel Alliance as Fulcrum and even fought him as Darth Vader on the planet Malachor. Wise and powerful, she was a well-respected warrior who stood up for peace and justice through her life.
